entries.title: GPT-6.1 Sol
entries.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol joins the catalog BYOK-only through OpenAI — 1.05M-token context, 128K max output, image input, and adjustable reasoning at $2 / $10 per million input / output tokens.

entries.title: Latest aliases: name a model family, always get a live model
entries.summary: Send google/gemini-flash-latest, anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest and 17 other -latest ids. AnyRouter calls the newest model in that family that is available right now, skips retired ones, and bills the model that answered.

entries.title: Liquid d1
entries.summary: Liquid AI's first decision model joins the Decisions family: send state and typed questions, get calibrated probabilities back with zero generated tokens. Free on Liquid's API with your own Liquid key.

entries.title: Solar Decide
entries.summary: Upstage's Solar Decide joins the Decisions family: send state and typed questions, get structured answers instead of chat text, with a 524,288-token context window at $0.05 per million input tokens.

entries.title: 3 models disabled
entries.summary: The only upstream no longer publishes inclusionai/ling-2.6-1t (live /models 2026-09-30); the Ling-3.0 family replaces it. (#3687) Plus 2 more.
